description_excerpt_as_observed:
What comes after smart contracts?

Charles Hoskinson takes the stage at Midnight City Tokyo to explore the evolution of blockchain—and what comes next.

From Bitcoin’s digital money to Ethereum’s programmable transactions and Cardano’s third-generation design, Charles reflects on how each generation builds on the last. He asks what the next leap could mean for cryptocurrency and the wider world of computing.

This recording begins with Charles’s opening remarks, following a short animated Input | Output intro.
